resources.string: For reliable background scheduled operations, allow the app to run without battery restrictions. This is especially important on Xiaomi, Huawei, and Samsung devices.
Set FastMediaSorter as your default media player
Tap a button below - a dialog will appear. Select FastMediaSorter and tap Always.
Your all-in-one media organizer.\nBrowse, sort, and manage files across local, network, and cloud storage - all with intuitive touch gestures.

FastMediaSorter brings every kind of media into one place. Open photos, videos, GIFs and music from your device, from a network share, or from cloud storage - and sort them with quick taps instead of long-press menus.\n\nEverything you set up here can be changed later in Settings, so there is no wrong choice on this screen - just tap Next to keep going.

Connect to any storage:

📱 LOCAL - Device folders, SD cards

🌐 NETWORK - SMB/CIFS, SFTP, FTP

☁️ CLOUD - Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox

Add resources in Settings anytime.

Local sources are folders on the device and SD cards. Network sources connect over SMB/CIFS, SFTP and FTP. Cloud sources link Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox.\n\nMix as many as you like - each source shows up as its own entry on the main screen. Add or remove sources any time from Settings → Resources.
Player uses 9 touch zones (3×3 grid) for quick actions. Tap zones to navigate, copy, move, delete files, or access the command panel. See the scheme above for details.

In full-screen image and video view the screen is split into a 3×3 grid. The corner zones jump between files, the edge zones run copy, move and delete on the current file, and the centre zone opens the command panel.\n\nThe small map above shows what each zone does. You can remap these actions later in Settings.

RESOURCES - Folders from any storage type.

QUICK SORT - Up to 30 color-coded destination folders for fast copy/move operations.

Configure in Settings anytime!

A resource is a folder you browse - from any storage type. A quick-sort destination is a folder you send files to with a single tap; you can define up to 30, each with its own colour and label.\n\nTap a colour while viewing a file to copy or move it there instantly. Set both up in Settings → Resources whenever you need.
Go beyond simple media viewing - FastMediaSorter packs professional tools for text, documents, and audio.

Beyond viewing, FastMediaSorter is also a player and a workshop: an audio player for your music libraries, a video library with playback controls, a PDF and EPUB reader, a text viewer and editor, on-image OCR and translation, a slideshow, home-screen widgets, scheduled file operations, favourites, and one-tap colour sorting.\n\nWhich of these are available depends on the app edition you installed - the cards below show what is included in yours.
FastMediaSorter needs access to your photos, videos, and audio files to scan and display media. We do not transfer your files to third parties.
Best for audio-only devices or MP3 players. Hides photos and videos; optimizes background audio and now-playing screen.
Best for Android car stereos. Uses extra-large buttons, locks screen on, and prioritizes media playback over file operations.
Best for e-readers or document tablets. Hides videos and music; optimizes PDF, EPUB, and text reading settings.
Best for tablets, Chromebooks, and Samsung DeX. Optimizes grid layout, enables large thumbnails, and allows multi-window browsing.
Best for dedicated media boxes. Focuses entirely on photos, videos, and music with automatic slideshow and resume features.
Keeps the default system settings unchanged. No batch presets will be applied automatically.
Best for personal phones. Optimizes touch layout, enables background synchronization, and keeps default security confirmations.
Turns the device into a digital photo frame. Disables video, audio, and file operations; opens slideshow immediately on launch.
Best for TV and media centers. Optimizes DPAD/remote navigation, uses large buttons, and hides tiny touch controls.
Best for video-only devices. Hides photos, music, and document viewers; prioritizes quick video playback and thumbnails.
Best for virtual reality devices. Pre-enables 3D/360° layouts and immersive controls on supported hardware flavors.
Touch Zones (Images/Video)\nuse in full screen view mode
Immerse yourself in your media.\nFastMediaSorter VR detects stereoscopic 3D content and renders it directly in your headset - no extra apps needed.
